description.en: Procolophon trigoniceps inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m TECHNICAL asset scale, not biological measurement. Cisneros2008 Fig1 published whole-life artist reconstruction and Fig2 BMNH R1726 skull dorsal and lateral; Fig4 multiple palates. Short broad triangular skull, stout neck and short sprawling limbs retained. Bony cheek processes with conservative keratin extension. Speculative minor head and back spines deliberately omitted, not armor. Tail tip, soft tissue, colors and pose artistic. No fossil surface or texture copying.
